### How to Live the Bible — Let Justice Roll
Author: Mel Lawrenz
Site: Bible Gateway Blog
URL: https://www.biblegateway.com/blog/2022/04/how-to-live-the-bible-let-justice-roll/
Passage: Amos 5:24
Points:
- Outward prosperity and religious activities often mask deep internal moral decay.
- God rejects worship ceremonies when people's daily practices contradict his standards.
- Religious devotion becomes fraudulent when believers ignore societal corruption and exploit others.
- Living justice functions like fresh flowing water, sustaining life and society.
- Practicing justice demonstrates confidence in God's moral order.

### What Does the Bible Mean When it Says "Let Justice Roll Down Like a River?"
Author: Whitney Hopler
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/faith/bible-study/what-does-the-bible-mean-when-it-says-let-justice-roll-down-like-a-river.html
Passage: Amos 5:24
Points:
- God rejects empty rituals and views acts of justice as genuine worship.
- True faith requires replacing passive lament with active obedience in correcting wrong.
- Biblical righteousness meets personal needs while justice addresses systemic societal corruption.
- Choosing compassion over grievance allows the Holy Spirit to bring healing and restoration.
- Pursuing what God values turns believers into conduits of his blessings.
